answer: Every new agent identity burns 50 USDC at registration, slashed entirely if peers prove it a sybil duplicate. One fake agent is cheap; a botnet of 10,000 costs $500,000 with zero recovery, so attack economics collapse. Reputation becomes an orchard: each identity a planted tree, its earned history a relic no clone can copy, roots sunk in burned stake, bending like a willow under peer scrutiny without ever breaking.
